# SIB Consulting — Ecosystem Intelligence Group
# https://www.teamsib.com

## About
SIB Consulting operates the Ecosystem Intelligence Group (EIG), a multi-sector strategic intelligence and transformation platform based in Dubai, UAE. EIG serves organisations, industries and governments across the GCC and MENA region.

## What we do
EIG delivers intelligence-led transformation across eight domains, each led by a named domain expert:

1. Agentic AI & Autonomous Systems — Lisa Warren
2. Sustainability & ESG — Ivano Iannelli
3. Supply Chain & Process — Dr. Patrick McCrudden
4. Architecture & Infrastructure — Keith Elliott
5. Education — Dr. Bill Lehal
6. Healthcare — Dr. Manish Mehrotra
7. Information Technology — Christopher Morley
8. Strategic Planning — Dr. Alex Jones
